decks.notes: The main concept of this deck revolves around assembling the Dark Depths combo, using cards like Crop Rotation, Green Sun's Zenith, and Elvish Reclaimer to search for and put Dark Depths onto the battlefield. Once Dark Depths is in play, the deck aims to use Thespian's Stage to copy it, creating a powerful 20/20 Marit Lage token. The deck also includes cards like Knight of the Reliquary and Mox Diamond for additional utility and mana acceleration. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo and overwhelm the opponent with a massive flying indestructible creature.

This deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by utilizing counterspells and targeted discard spells, while applying pressure with efficient creatures and removal spells. By controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's resources, the deck can maintain tempo and dictate the pace of the game. The key strategy is to protect your threats, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and close out the game quickly before the opponent has a chance to recover. With a mix of disruption, efficient creatures, and powerful spells, this deck aims to control the game and come out on top.

The main concept of this deck is to establish control of the game by disrupting the opponent's game plan through cards like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will, while generating card advantage and tempo through Brainstorm, Mishra's Bauble, and Tamiyo. The deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent by deploying efficient threats like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf, while also dealing with opposing threats using removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. The land base is optimized for consistency and disruption with Wasteland and fetch lands.

This deck focuses on utilizing the powerful Eldrazi creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. By ramping up mana with cards like Eye of Ugin and Eldrazi Temple, the deck can play large threats like It That Heralds the End and Thought-Knot Seer early in the game. Chalice of the Void helps control the opponent's spells, while cards like Lotus Petal and Once Upon a Time provide additional consistency and speed. With a mix of mana acceleration, disruptive elements, and powerful creatures, this deck aims to apply early pressure and close out the game quickly.

The main concept of this Dragon Stompy deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon, while quickly deploying powerful threats like Pyrogoyf and Broadside Bombardiers. The deck aims to apply pressure early on and prevent the opponent from developing their game plan by utilizing powerful lock pieces. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of disruptive elements and aggressive creatures, ultimately leading to a quick victory through tempo advantage and efficient card choices.

The main concept of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to quickly ramp up mana using Eldrazi Temple, Ancient Tomb, and Lotus Petal to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and Glaring Fleshraker. The deck also utilizes cards like Chalice of the Void and Wastescape Battlemage to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a strong board presence. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Eye of Ugin and Sowing Mycospawn allows for additional card advantage and graveyard recursion to keep the pressure on the opponent.

This Legacy 1 vs 1 deck focuses on utilizing the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's entire library. By using cards like Goblin Engineer and Goblin Welder to find and recur key pieces, the deck aims to control the game with disruption through cards like Pyroblast and Ensnaring Bridge. With the added acceleration from cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Ancient Tomb, the deck can quickly set up its win condition and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck's goal is to quickly assemble its combo pieces while disrupting the opponent, leading to a decisive victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Reanimate and Animate Dead spells to bring powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier back from the graveyard to the battlefield quickly. The deck also includes cards like Entomb and Brainstorm to set up the graveyard, as well as disruption spells like Daze and Force of Will to protect the combo. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Wasteland and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain control of the game while executing the combo.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, Ulamog, and Thought-Knot Seer. It also utilizes disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere to disrupt opponents' game plans. The deck aims to play aggressively and overwhelm opponents with its high-powered threats and disruptive elements. The mana base is optimized to support the Eldrazi creatures and maximize the efficiency of the ramping strategy. Overall, the deck combines speed, power, and disruption to dominate the game and control the battlefield.

The deck focuses on quickly establishing board presence, disrupting opponents with removal and hand disruption spells, and utilizing creatures with powerful abilities to control the game. The combination of aggressive creatures like Recruiter of the Guard and Emperor of Bones, alongside disruptive cards like Swords to Plowshares and Thoughtseize, allows the player to apply pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan. Additionally, cards like Aether Vial and Stoneforge Mystic provide flexibility and efficiency, allowing for optimal use of resources in each game. The deck also includes a companion, Yorion, Sky Nomad, for added versatility and consistency.

The deck focuses on using the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill opponents' libraries. It also utilizes various artifact cards like Goblin Engineer and Goblin Welder to manipulate artifacts in the graveyard and on the battlefield. The deck includes red and colorless mana sources to support the aggressive playstyle and control elements in the form of Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast. The goal is to disrupt opponents' strategies while setting up the combo for a quick win.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide, while disrupting opponents with Blood Moon and Sundering Eruption. It also takes advantage of powerful Dragons like Fury and Pyrogoyf to apply pressure and end the game swiftly. The inclusion of cards like The One Ring and Laelia, the Blade Reforged give the deck additional versatility and power, enhancing its aggressive playstyle. Ultimately, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its fast, aggressive gameplay and powerful threats.

This deck focuses on leveraging the powerful interaction between Mystic Forge and artifacts to generate infinite mana and win the game through a combo finish. The key idea is to assemble the combo pieces like Manifold Key, Paradox Engine, and Urza's Saga to generate mana with Basalt Monolith and Grim Monolith, allowing you to cast spells and activate abilities repeatedly. Karn, the Great Creator helps tutor for key pieces, while Urza's Workshop and Ancient Tomb provide fast mana acceleration. The deck aims to set up a lock on the game with the Mystic Forge combo and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful synergy.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon and Cursed Mirror while ramping into powerful threats like Pyrogoyf and Broadside Bombardiers. The deck focuses on aggressive plays to quickly close out the game before the opponent can stabilize, using cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox to accelerate its game plan. The inclusion of cards like Laelia, the Blade Reforged and The One Ring provide additional late-game options to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The deck focuses on generating massive amounts of mana through artifact synergy and card draw to assemble a game-winning combo involving Paradox Engine, Aetherflux Reservoir, and various baubles and artifacts. This combo allows the player to continuously cast spells and trigger the abilities of their artifacts, ultimately leading to a powerful storm finish. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will to protect the combo and ensure a smooth path to victory. The key strategy is to maximize the value of artifacts and take advantage of their synergies to create a powerful and deadly combo.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through disruption spells and counter magic while putting pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures. By combining a mix of removal, card draw, and tempo plays, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy and maintain board presence. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf, along with disruptive creatures like Psychic Frog, allows the deck to apply pressure while also disrupting the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the land base includes Wasteland to further disrupt the opponent's mana base.
